source: GShard then integrated sparsely gated ZXNAME0000XZ into Transformers and demonstrated automatic sharding of a multilingual translation model beyond 600B parameters. Switch Transformer simplified routing to a single selected expert and studied training stability, load balance, and capacity at large scale.
zh: 然后，GShard 将稀疏门控 ZXNAME0000XZ 集成到 Transformers 中，并演示了超过 600B 参数的多语言翻译模型的自动分片。 Switch Transformer 简化了对单个选定专家的路由，并研究了大规模的训练稳定性、负载平衡和容量。
